type: graph-only, no Amelia observations, no live inflow

perturbation.displacement: Each zone d with finite directed dist(a,d)>=2 AND finite directed dist(d,a). Target order ascending. Start-zone pointer only.
perturbation.delaySemantics: During ticks 1 and 2 continue autonomous transitions without newly admitted input; queue the two input symbols and resume consumption in original order at tick 3; count all ticks toward 24.
perturbation.identifyInstanceAs: ordered anchor a plus perturbation kind and displacement target

null.perStep: uniform over canonical open outgoing gates, independent of PFM, Governor, input and source activation
null.referenceState: same displaced/start zone, same 24-tick clock and L2 schedule
null.exactCurve: first post-perturbation visit to turning zone b followed later by anchor a; P(T<=t), t=0..24
null.win: intact via-b first recovery at tick t<=24 with P_null(T<=t)<=1/4

scanner.turningZone: farthest interior visited zone by shortest directed path back to anchor; ties earliest; unordered pair for naming

encounter.memory: (intact comparative-win count - PFM-reset comparative-win count)/N >= 1/4, N all applicable perturbations of that pair; compute against same per-instance analytic null curves
encounter.integration: at least one comparative win in intact and sham that is abolished by selective suppression under same instance, retaining existing form

controls.pureRecurrenceWalker: Original fixed first-outgate canonical negative reference; included separately and duplicated within eight-policy family
controls.nonBranchingZones: unique outgoing edge; absorbing dwell at sinks
controls.negativeRequirement: zero encounters for each of baseline and all eight policies; independently report goal-only passes

provenance.requiredPreRunReview: Operator review of committed constants and analytical eligibility curves; no run without further approval
